notes: Read the web source line by line and reproduced its full tree with React Native primitives. No DOM/HTML elements (h3/h4/div/span), lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, or old web UI components are imported.

Imports L1-11: useTranslation (L1) -> inlined native English-default `t(key, fallback)` that returns the fallback, keeping every costAnalysis.* key verbatim (the DetailedStatistics idiom; no {{var}} interpolation occurs in this source). Clock from lucide-react (L2) -> inline '◷' glyph in text-amber-400 (#fbbf24) (the DetailedStatistics inline-heading-icon idiom). GlassPanel from @/components/ui (L3) -> shared native GlassPanel. The @/components/charts barrel (L4-8: ChartTooltip, chartGrid, axisTickSm, BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, Cell) -> NOT imported; the whole Recharts chart is reproduced natively (see L31-62 note). useChartPalette from @/hooks/useChartPalette (L9) -> inlined native useChartPalette() reading `chart_palette` from the native useSettings query + verbatim resolveChartPalette/CHART_COLORS_CB_SAFE/CHART_COLORS_NEON from @/lib/colors. fmtNumber/fmtInt from @/lib/numberFormat (L10) -> inlined safeNumber()+fmtNumber()/fmtInt() mirror (nullish/NaN->0, en-US grouping at the web global default precision 2). `import type { HourBucket, TouInsights } from './types'` (L11) -> inlined interfaces (native ./types is not yet a converted target, the TimeToChargeSection TimeToChargeMetrics idiom); HourBucket/TouInsights copied verbatim from web ./types so cheapest/priciest/busiest (HourBucket) keep .label/.avgCost/.sessions and offPeakPct stays number.

TimeOfUseAnalysisProps L13-16 preserved verbatim (hourlyData: HourBucket[]; touInsights: TouInsights | null). Component signature L18 `export function TimeOfUseAnalysis({ hourlyData, touInsights })` preserved (named export, like the web). useTranslation (L19) -> inlined t. useChartPalette() (L20) -> inlined hook; `palette` kept as the variable name so `palette[0]` (web L57) ports verbatim. Added maxSessions = reduce(Math.max(safeNumber(sessions))) || 1 and yTicks=[max, round(max/2), 0] to drive the native bar heights + y-axis (the data the Recharts YAxis derived internally).

Outer GlassPanel className='p-4' (L23) -> styles.root padding 16. h3 (L24-27): `flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white` -> styles.titleRow (row, align center, gap 8, marginBottom 16 for mb-4) with the inline '◷' Clock glyph (amber-400) + AppText semibold 14px textPrimary carrying t('costAnalysis.tou.title','Electricity Rate Analysis (Time-of-Use)') verbatim (L25-26).

Outer `grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6` (L28) -> styles.grid (single column stack, gap 24) — the native narrow layout matches the web grid-cols-1 mobile breakpoint; the lg:3-col / col-span-2 split degrades to a vertical stack (chart section then insights section).

Bar chart L30-67: the `lg:col-span-2` wrapper (L30) -> styles.chartCol. `hourlyData.length > 0 ?` (L31) gate preserved. The ResponsiveContainer/BarChart/CartesianGrid/XAxis/YAxis/Tooltip/Bar/Cell (L32-61) are reproduced as a native vertical-bar histogram: styles.chartRow holds a 3-tick y-axis (max/mid/0 via fmtInt, styles.yAxis space-between, mirroring the Recharts YAxis tickFormatter `${v}`) + a plotColumn whose barsArea (height 220, align flex-end) renders one View per hour. The Bar's per-Cell colour map (L50-58) is ported VERBATIM: const isPeak = entry.hour>=14 && entry.hour<=19; const isOffPeak = entry.hour>=22 || entry.hour<6; const color = isPeak ? '#ef4444' : isOffPeak ? '#10b981' : palette[0]; each bar height = (safeNumber(entry.sessions)/maxSessions)*100% with the Bar radius={[3,3,0,0]} (L48) -> borderTopLeft/RightRadius 3; key={entry.hour} (L58) preserved. XAxis dataKey='label' interval={2} (L35-39) -> styles.xAxis labels rendered every 3rd cell (i % 3 === 0, matching Recharts interval={2} tick indexing) using entry.label.

Tooltip content={<ChartTooltip/>} (L44): Recharts hover tooltips depend on browser SVG pointer events and have no native equivalent; instead each bar carries accessibilityLabel `${entry.label}: ${fmtInt(entry.sessions)} ${t('costAnalysis.tou.sessions','Sessions')}` so the tooltip's per-bar session info survives for touch/screen-reader users (the SmallMultiplesChart tooltip-unavailable idiom). chartGrid (CartesianGrid props) and axisTickSm (fontSize 10) collapse into the static native axis styling (styles.axisTick fontSize 10).

Empty chart branch L63-67: `flex h-[260px] items-center justify-center text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]` -> styles.chartEmpty (height 260, centered) + AppText tone='muted' carrying t('costAnalysis.charts.noData','Not enough data') verbatim.

Legend L69-91 (rendered unconditionally, outside the chart ternary, exactly as the web): `mt-2 flex justify-center gap-6` -> styles.legend (row, wrap, justify center, gap 24, marginTop 8). Three legendItems (gap-1.5 -> gap 6) each with an h-3 w-3 rounded-full dot (styles.legendDot 12px circle) + an AppText caption muted: bg-red-500 (#ef4444) + t('costAnalysis.tou.peak','Peak (2–7 PM)') (L72-75); bg-[#00f0ff] + t('costAnalysis.tou.midPeak','Mid-peak') (L78-83); bg-green-500 (#22c55e) + t('costAnalysis.tou.offPeak','Off-peak (10 PM–6 AM)') (L86-89). Dot hues used verbatim.

ToU insights L94-156: the right `space-y-3` column (L95) -> styles.insightsCol (gap 12). h4 (L96-98) `text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-muted)]` -> AppText caption/muted + styles.insightsHeading (fontWeight 500, letterSpacing 0.8, textTransform uppercase) carrying t('costAnalysis.tou.insights','Insights'). `touInsights ?` (L99) gate preserved. The four repeated `<GlassPanel className='p-3'>` blocks (L101-149) collapse to a shared InsightPanel (DRY) rendering label (text-xs muted), value (mt-1 text-lg font-semibold + colour, marginTop 4), and a text-[10px] muted sub.

Insight panels ported with verbatim copy, colours, and number formatting: Cheapest (L101-113) value=touInsights.cheapest.label in text-green-400 (#4ade80), sub `${t('costAnalysis.tou.avgCost','avg')} $${fmtNumber(cheapest.avgCost,3)} ${t('costAnalysis.tou.perSession','/ session')}` (L109-111). Priciest (L114-126) value=priciest.label in text-red-400 (#f87171), same avgCost(3)/perSession sub (L122-124). Busiest (L127-138) value=busiest.label in text-cyan-400 (#22d3ee), sub `${fmtInt(busiest.sessions)} ${t('costAnalysis.tou.sessions','sessions')}` (L135-136). Off-Peak (L139-149) value `${fmtNumber(offPeakPct,1)}%` (L144) in text-emerald-400 (#34d399), sub t('costAnalysis.tou.offPeakDesc','of sessions between 10 PM–6 AM') (L147). All -300/-400 hues used verbatim (no exact token), matching the engineering toned-down map.

Empty insights branch L151-155: `flex h-32 items-center justify-center text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]` -> styles.insightsEmpty (height 128, centered) + AppText tone='muted' carrying t('costAnalysis.tou.noInsights','No insights available'). Closing tags L156-160 mapped to the native View/GlassPanel close; added TimeOfUseAnalysis.displayName.
